name: Classify files
info:
Determines which files on an entry can be transferred to the target system.

### Input
- msg.payload.files — array of file objects                                                                                                                                                      
- msg.metadata.source / msg.metadata.target — client objects                                                                                                                                     
   
### Logic                                                                                                                                                                                        
Checks source.can_upload && target.can_download via system attributes.
Rejects unsigned Rayvn API URLs (missing sig= parameter).                                                                                                                                        
Flags oversized files based on target.max_upload_bytes.                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                   
### Output (2 ports)                                                                                                                                                                             
- Port 1: msg with metadata.files.items (transferable files) — at least one item                                                                                                                 
- Port 2: msg with metadata.files.failed (all files failed or non-transferable)

name: Classify files
